answer: A P-256 key is generated in hardware, and the attestation proves it never left the chip. The attestation chain is verified each epoch, and a fresh signature is demanded. A farm needs 226 separate P-256 keys, since one hardware key cannot serve 226 identities. A spiral marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the ocean ledger turns 226 aliases into 226 bills while the juniper path for the honest stays a single payment.
